ladder.classBlurb: The Wizard studies magic of the veil and mirror, spells that reveal and conceal.
The Wizard writes contracts in Heaven and Hell, wielding the power of the written word and the sealed agreement.
The Wizard learns that magic need not follow rules, bending spells into impossible shapes.
The Wizard learns spells written in the deep, words that press down with crushing weight.
The Wizard learns the living history of magic, reading spells written in the rings of time.
The Wizard maps the stars, learning magic from distant worlds and horizons.
The Wizard writes spells with nothing, magic that erases and unmakes.
The Wizard collects spells the world has forgotten, magic that should not exist.
The Wizard writes the first Laws of magic, a mortal hand that can rewrite reality.

subclasses.ds: A wizard who draws power from the stars and the vast emptiness of space, wielding cosmic forces.
Elven-style wizards who fuse swordplay with spellcasting. (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything)
A wizard who nudges moments rather than commanding time outright, borrowing reactions and recasting spent spells.
Wizards who manipulate time. (Explorer's Guide to Wildemount)
Wizards who manipulate gravity. (Explorer's Guide to Wildemount)
Wizards whose spellbook is awakened and alive. (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything)
A wizard who studies runes as a second, slower spellbook, inscribing wards and recalling spent spell slots.
Wizards of protective and warding magic. (Player's Handbook)
Wizards who summon creatures and objects. (Player's Handbook)
Wizards who read the future. (Player's Handbook)
Wizards who charm and bewilder. (Player's Handbook)
A wizard specialized in raw destructive magic, with the rare ability to protect allies from their own area spells.
Wizards of deception and phantasm. (Player's Handbook)
Wizards who study the magic of death and undeath. (File is named to avoid clashing with this vault's Necromancy Rune and spell school.) (Player's Handbook)
Wizards who change matter and form. (Player's Handbook)
A wizard who studies the Void as an academic subject rather than a power to wield lightly, folding space and unraveling magic.
Wizards who blend spells and defense on the battlefield. (Xanathar's Guide to Everything)
